law: ADA Title II; DOJ web and mobile app accessibility rule (adopted 2024-04-24)
scope: State and local government entities (web content and mobile apps)
enforcement: DOJ enforcement; private suits under Title II
effective: Compliance 2027-04-26 for entities serving 50000 or more people; 2028-04-26 for entities serving fewer than 50000 and special district governments
notes: Dates were extended by a DOJ interim final rule (Federal Register 2026-07663 published 2026-04-20; the original dates were 2026-04-26 and 2027-04-26). Technical standard is WCAG 2.1 AA, not 2.2

standard_referenced: No DOJ technical standard for websites
scope: Places of public accommodation (businesses open to the public)
notes: DOJ guidance says it has no regulation setting detailed web standards and names WCAG and the Section 508 Standards only as helpful guidance with no legally binding effect. The 2024 Title II rule does not apply to Title III. Courts and settlements often cite WCAG; case law not re-verified
